entry.description: Absolute amplitude threshold gate detector on a realtime signal

arguments.name: maxsize
arguments.description: The size of the buffer to allocate at instantiation time for keeping track of the time-critical conditions (,,,,, and). This cannot be modulated. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: highpassfreq
attributes.digest: High-Pass Filter Cutoff
attributes.description: The frequency of the fourth-order Linkwitz-Riley high-pass filter () applied to the input signal to minimise low frequency intermodulation with very short ramp lengths. A frequency of 0 bypasses the filter. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: lookahead
attributes.digest: Forward Lookup Length
attributes.description: When an offset is detected, the algorithm will wait this duration (in samples) to find a minimum in the envelope follower to identify as the offset point. This affects the latency of the algorithm (see latency equation in the description). Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: lookback
attributes.digest: Backward Lookup Length
attributes.description: When an onset is detected, the algorithm will look in the recent past (via an internal recorded buffer of this length in samples) for a minimum in the envelope follower to identify as the onset point. This affects the latency of the algorithm (see latency equation in the description). Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: minlengthabove
attributes.digest: Required Minimum Length Above Threshold
attributes.description: The length in samples that the envelope must be above the threshold to consider it a valid transition to 1. The gate will change to 1 at the first sample when the condition is met. Therefore, this affects the latency (see latency equation in the description). Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: minlengthbelow
attributes.digest: Required Minimum Length Below Threshold
attributes.description: The length in samples that the envelope must be below the threshold to consider it a valid transition to 0. The gate will change to 0 at the first sample when the condition is met. Therefore, this affects the latency (see latency equation in the description). Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: minsilencelength
attributes.digest: Minimum Length of Silence
attributes.description: The minimum length in samples for which the gate will stay closed. Changes of states during that period after an offset will be ignored. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: minslicelength
attributes.digest: Minimum Length of Slice
attributes.description: The minimum length in samples for which the gate will stay open. Changes of states during this period after an onset will be ignored. Constraints Minimum:

attributes.name: offthreshold
attributes.digest: Off Threshold
attributes.description: The threshold in dB of the envelope follower to trigger an offset: go from 1 (open) to 0 (closed). Constraints Minimum: Maximum:

attributes.name: onthreshold
attributes.digest: On Threshold
attributes.description: The threshold in dB of the envelope follower to trigger an onset: go from 0 (closed) to 1 (open). Constraints Minimum: Maximum:
